AppConfig.title: AppConfig
AppConfig.description: Global branding, lock screen messaging, and payment gateway configuration managed by the admin panel.

companyName.description: Display name of the EMI company

logoUrl.description: HTTPS URL for the company logo

lockBackgroundUrl.description: HTTPS URL for the full-screen lock background image

paymentInstructions.description: Short payment instruction note on the lock screen

Device.title: Device
Device.description: Enrolled customer device state and installment status keyed by Android ID without user login.

deviceId.description: Unique Android ID of the enrolled device

status.description: Current lock state of the device

fcmToken.description: FCM registration token for backup lock/unlock push notifications

lastSeen.description: Server timestamp of last device check-in

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Installment payment order created and verified server-side via Cloud Functions.

deviceId.description: Android ID associated with this payment order

pin.description: 6-digit unlock PIN generated server-side upon payment confirmation

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when order was created

DeviceTask.title: DeviceTask
DeviceTask.description: Admin-defined task assigned to a specific device or all devices.

deviceId.description: Target Android device ID or 'all' for global tasks

description.description: Short task description written by admin

steps.description: Ordered list of plain-text step instructions

requiresPermission.description: Optional runtime permission required when starting the task

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when task was created

GlobalTaskCompletion.title: GlobalTaskCompletion
GlobalTaskCompletion.description: Per-device completion marker for global tasks where deviceId == 'all'.

/config/app.description: Global application branding, messaging, and payment gateway URL.

/devices/{deviceId}.description: Registered customer devices keyed by unique Android ID.

/devices/{deviceId}/taskCompletions/{tas.description: Per-device completion records for global tasks.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Installment payment orders managed by Cloud Functions.
